verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers what Microsoft Graph's Outlook mail APIs can do (send, rules, sync, change notifications), but no item describes API versioning or a deprecation policy. The only hint is the 'view=graph-rest-1.0' parameter in some doc URLs, which implies a v1.0 API but is not affirmative documentation of a versioning scheme. Nothing at all addresses deprecation timelines or policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
